category: analytics for mobile and desktop apps (SDKs, hosted)

free_tier.stated: Free plan: 20,000 events per month with no credit card required; unlimited apps, EU or US data residency, built-in and live dashboards, session timeline and CSV export; there are no overage fees and past the limit analytics are paused until the start of the next month
free_tier.notes: The unit is the event: every call to the SDK's track function counts as one, and nothing is tracked automatically. The vocabulary has no events term, so requests is the nearest. The next plan is USD 10 a month for 200,000 events.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-event size is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: unverified: no retention period is stated on the pages read

egress.terms: Export to CSV is included on every plan; no export allowance or price beyond that is stated

interface_detail: Events are sent by SDKs for popular platforms and read in the built-in dashboard or exported to CSV; no REST read API is named on the pages read, and the interface vocabulary has no term for an SDK-only service.
tooling: SDKs for popular platforms, the dashboard and CSV export
chaining: Usage events from a desktop or mobile app, up to 20,000 a month, kept in the EU or the US region.

limits.value: 20,000 events per month; past it analytics are paused until the start of the next month

binding_note: The 20,000-event monthly cap is the only stated quota, and exceeding it pauses collection instead of billing.

identity_cost.detail: The pricing page states no credit card is required for the free plan; the sign-up page offers GitHub or Google sign-in, or a name and an email address that receives a magic link, in the EU or the US region.

reliability_note: past 20,000 events a month analytics are temporarily disabled until the start of the next month; an email warns before the limit
confidence_note: The plan, the overage rule and the sign-up methods are quoted from first-party pages. No account was opened, so retention and any later sign-up step are unverified: behind a sign-up.
